Tell the ladies.''"
"''I was working base defense at Rothana.''"
"''A ''shipyard'' at Rothana, which is not so far from here.|Corlac and Terex|}} '''Rothana''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Rothana system]]. It had arctic regions that were home to the [[arctic horny whelmer]]. The world was sold to the [[Kuat Drive Yards]] (KDY) vehicle building company around [[800 BBY]] and hosted the KDY subsidiary [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]] (RHE). The subsidiary had its hand in technological developments, and the [[KDY corporate-security starfleet]] also defended the Rothana system from any [[Spy|espionage]] from the [[Trade Federation]] corporation. From around [[31 BBY]], Kuat and Rothana were secretly contracted by the [[Kaminoan]]s to develop new vehicles for the [[Galactic Republic]]'s new [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]]. RHE designed a number of new vehicles, with the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] being the company's first [[Starship|starcraft]] and the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] being inspired by Rothana's arctic horny whelmers. These vehicles made their debut at the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] in [[22 BBY]]. After the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]], Rothana continued to contribute to the [[Galactic Empire]], the Republic's successor, but was a shadow of its former self and began to specialize in ground vehicle production primarily. The world continued to contribute to the [[Imperial Military]]'s war efforts, including against a [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] in [[14 BBY]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] against the Empire considered Rothana's Imperial facilities as a possible target in [[3 ABY]]. In [[5 ABY]], all Imperial personnel on Rothana were redirected to the planet [[Jakku]], where the Empire met its [[Battle of Jakku|demise]]. After the Empire's fall, Rothana's [[Rothana Imperial Shipyards|shipyards]] remained abandoned until a [[Scavenger|salvager]] crew infiltrated the facility with the help of one of its former security, the ex-[[stormtrooper]] [[Terex]]. The crew stole an array of abandoned Imperial ships, including the mothballed [[corvette]] known as the ''[[Carrion Spike]]''. ==Description== [[File:Rothana-SWT.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rothana's galactic surroundings]] Rothana was a terrestrial [[planet]] located in the [[Quiberon sector]]'s [[Rothana system]] within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and [[the Slice]]. It was situated at the coordinates T-15 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. A primarily arctic world with [[mineral]]-rich soil, Rothana appeared [[Color|orange-brown]] from above. The arctic regions of the world included [[Water|icy]] cliffs and strong wind gusts. The world was [[Homeworld|home]] to the [[arctic horny whelmer]], a [[Limb|ten-legged]] creature found in Rothana's arctic regions that hunted in packs, wearing their prey out with persistence. ==History== ===Republic era=== ====Corporate politics==== {{Quote|Dignitaries from across the galaxy shelter within the Rothana experimental walker, as Stellan Gios deflects the Nihil attack.|Jedi Master Harli Cogra, ''Chronicles of the Jedi''|''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi]]''}} [[File:KDY.svg|thumb|left|250px|The logo of Kuat Drive Yards, the company that purchased Rothana]] Around [[800 BBY]], Rothana was sold to the [[Kuat Drive Yards]] (KDY), a vehicle manufacturing company headquartered on the planet [[Kuat]].''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' KDY established its subsidiary [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]] (RHE) on Rothana's rich soil, which bolstered the company's profits. Over the [[Standard year|years]], RHE was among a number of technology companies in [[the galaxy]] that were developing [[Gravity|gravitational]] manipulation technology,''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' and the company was developing [[walker]] vehicles by the [[High Republic Era]]. One [[Rothana experimental walker|experimental walker]] was sent from Rothana to the [[Valo Republic Fair|Republic Fair]] on the planet [[Valo]]''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' in [[231 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' where many different cultural and technological marvels were brought to display from across the [[galaxy]]. The walker was used as cover by some dignitaries, including [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Lina Soh]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], when the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] [[Valo Atrocity|attacked]] the [[Republic Fair|fair]], but it was eventually destroyed by the attackers, injuring some of the dignitaries. The walker's part in the attack was mentioned in the fourth chapter of [[Jedi Master]] [[Harli Cogra]]'s ''[[Chronicles of the Jedi]]'' publication in [[229 BBY]].{{ChroniclesoftheJediDate}} In [[33 BBY]],{{InsiderCite|200|A Certain Point of View}} states that the [[Eriadu Conference|Eriadu trade summit]] took place thirty-three [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[33 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. leading [[Kuati]] executives were [[assassin]]ated at the [[Eriadu Conference]], an incident that saw a [[Neimoidian faction|Neimoidian]] takeover of the [[Trade Federation]] corporation and a failed [[Death|assassination]] attempt on Republic [[Chancellor|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]].{{InsiderCite|200|A Certain Point of View}} The industrialists at Kuat Drive Yards were outraged with the Trade Federation afterward, and Rothana Heavy Engineering itself kept no friendship with the corporation. the Rothana system was additionally defended by the [[KDY corporate-security starfleet]], with [[mine]]s being deployed inventively in Rothana's inbound [[hyperspace route]]s. Those measures, along with [[Rothanian]] etiquette for outsiders, kept the system clear of any Trade Federation [[Spy|espionage]]. ====Building for an army==== After the [[Kaminoan]]s began secretly making a [[Cloning|clone]] [[army]] for the Republic in [[32 BBY]], the Kuat Drive Yards received an order from a secret buyer to produce masses of [[weapon]]s in [[31 BBY]]. As Rothana was not far from the Kaminoan homeworld of [[Kamino]], the [[Ruling Council (Kamino)|Kaminoan government]] secretly commissioned Rothana Heavy Engineering to develop [[starship]]s and ground vehicles to support an army.{{HelmetCollectionCite|33|Weapons & Uniforms}} RHE's [[Factory|factories]] and [[orbit]]al [[shipyard]]s at Rothana secretly produced an array of vehicles for the Republic. [[File:Acclamator-TCWIV.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Acclamator''-class assault ship was the first starship produced at Rothana.]] The [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] was the first starcraft developed by RHE and was built on Rothana{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} under [[Project Icefang]].{{GermanFanCite|93|Database}} The [[assault ship]]s were also the first intergalactic [[warship]]s to be built in [[Standard decade|decades]]. Other notable vehicles developed by the company included the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]], the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]], and the [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery]] Turbolaser.[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] The All Terrain Tactical Enforcer's design was inspired by Rothana's native arctic horny whelmer, taking on multiple qualities of the creature, such as its ability to withstand strong winds when crossing icy cliffs. ====Limitations in war==== {{Quote|These shield generators…Are they designed for cities as defensive umbrellas?''"
"''They're designed for capital ships.''"
"''I don't understand. Rothana's ships are capable of withstanding most of what the Separatists can deliver in the way of laser—of projectile fire.|[[Galen Walton Erso]] and fellow [[scientist]] [[Reeva Demesne]]|''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''}} The Trade Federation and other corporate bodies like the [[Techno Union]], while officially holding a neutral [[Politics|political]] stance, became founding members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]], a rival government to the Republic that was formed following the [[Raxus Address]]''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' of [[24 BBY]].''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' states that the [[Raxus Address]] took place two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[22 BBY]]. Therefore, the Raxus Address must have occurred in [[24 BBY]]. Kuat Drive Yards' grudge with the Trade Federation led to the company, along with Rothana, aligning with the Republic. [[File:LAATc_Geonosis_1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Rothana's new vehicles debuted at the First Battle of Geonosis.]] The new vehicles designed and built by Rothana Heavy Engineering made up an overwhelming majority in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|37|Weapons & Uniforms}} In [[22 BBY]], the [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] went to Kamino to inspect the clone army. During Yoda's mission, a [[Rothana assault ship fleet|fleet]] of twelve''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' ''Acclamator''-class assault ships were sent straight from Rothana to pick up the clone forces before being deployed against the Separatists in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]]. The battle was the debut for the new vehicles developed by Rothana for the Republic and the use of the Acclamators was successful enough that the Republic ordered several more from Rothana Heavy Engineering. As the war continued, limitations to some of RHE's vehicles became more apparent. While existing ones were upgraded, the ''Acclamator''-class assault ship was largely replaced by the more combat-orientated [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] developed by Kuat Drive Yards. ===Imperial era=== ====Changes in power==== {{Quote|On the Admiralty's counsel, the navy is now redirecting resources from as far away as Rothana and Bothawui.|[[Harus Ison]], [[Deputy Director]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], reports on the pursuit of the ''Carrion Spike''|}} [[File:RothanaHangar-PoeDameron9.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Carrion Spike'' was mothballed at Rothana's Imperial shipyards.]] At the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]], the Republic [[Proclamation of the New Order|transitioned]] into the [[Galactic Empire]]. While the Kuat Drive Yards came to gain a near monopoly on warship contracts for the [[Imperial Navy]], Rothana Heavy Engineering became a shadow of what it had been, beginning to specialize in ground effort and [[repulsorlift]] [[armor]]ed vehicles. It produced products for the Empire such as the [[TX-225 Occupier]] line,''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' the [[All Terrain Personal Transport]],''[[Savage Spirits]]'' and the [[Scout-class 2-M repulsor tank|''Scout''-class 2-M repulsor tank]].''[[Starships and Speeders]]'' Rothana still made some flight vehicles like the [[Imperial Dropship Transport]],''[[Forged in Battle]]'' with Kuat Drive Yards licensing the company to manufacture the [[Onager-class Star Destroyer|''Onager''-class Star Destroyer]]. The [[Rothana Imperial Shipyards|Imperial shipyards]] above Rothana served to repair and construct Imperial starships, including [[starfighter]]s from the [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]]. Mechanical components built in the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Imperial prison complex]] on the nearby [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]] were shipped to Rothana. In [[14 BBY]], a [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] led by the ex–[[Republic Intelligence]] [[Intelligence officer|officer]] [[Berch Teller]] [[Mission to Murkhana|stole]] the ''[[Carrion Spike]]'', the personal [[corvette]] of Imperial [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. In the Empire's [[Berch Teller campaign|hunt]] for the ''Carrion Spike'', which attacked multiple Imperial facilities, the Imperial Navy redirected ships from as far as Rothana and the [[gas giant]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' [[Bothawui]] under the Imperial [[Admiralty (Imperial)|Admiralty's]] counsel. [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] eventually recovered a damaged ''Carrion Spike''. After Tarkin's death during the [[Battle of Yavin]], the corvette was mothballed at Rothana's shipyards.{{HelmetCollectionCite|74|Highlights of the Saga}} ====War effort==== {{Quote|Now, when they pulled you out, were there many ships left there?''"
"''Yes. A good number, all sizes. Some were still under construction, some were being repaired—they weren't battle-ready, or they'd have gone to Jakku.|Corlac and Terex|}} [[File:Rothana-RF.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Rothana was among the Galactic Empire's major industrial assets.]] By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], the Rothana Imperial Shipyards were among the Empire's most major shipyards. After the Alliance's [[61st Mobile Infantry]] caught early success in a campaign named [[Operation Ringbreaker]] that sought the eventual sabotage of the Kuat Drive Yards''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' in [[3 ABY]], [[General]] [[Crix Madine]] considered potential future targets for the Alliance should the 61st's campaign succeed. He made a [[Star map|map]] of the Empire's major shipyards, [[drydock]]s, and key [[mining]] centers, with Rothana being marked as a high-priority, high-security target. The [[map]] was included in a report on Madine's proposal, which was sent to the Alliance's [[Commander-in-Chief]] [[Mon Mothma]]. Operation Ringbreaker ultimately failed to reach Kuat. In [[4 ABY]], the Empire suffered a catastrophic defeat at the [[Battle of Endor]] in which [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] was killed. The Alliance [[Declaration of a New Republic|reorganized]] into the [[New Republic]] and defeated the Empire in many subsequent battles. In [[5 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral]] [[Gallius Rax]] began redirecting Imperial forces to the planet [[Jakku]] in preparation for a final battle. The Empire abandoned the Rothana shipyards, taking all operational starships as well as all Imperial personnel, including the [[stormtrooper]] [[Terex]]. The shipyards were, in turn, shut down, with auto-security being activated and [[droid]]s staying as guards. ===New Republic era=== {{Quote|Ok, so here's what we have—a shipyard full of Imperial warships that just need a little repair work to be ready to go. We have a trooper who was stationed at that shipyard, and knows all the access codes to get in. No way anyone's changed them since Jakku, right?''"
"''Right, we shut down the facility before we left. Turned on auto-security, droids and so on, but—''"
"''And we ''also'' have two wonderful people who happen to run a large ship repair and salvage operation. They've agreed to help us in exchange for any ships or parts we can't use.|Corlac and Terex|}} [[File:RothanaInfiltration-PoeDameron9.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Terex helps the ship salvagers infiltrate Rothana's abandoned shipyards.]] The New Republic [[Battle of Jakku|defeated]] the Empire at Jakku and won the war thereafter. Having escaped the engagement, Terex and fellow stormtrooper [[Corlac]] fled Jakku around [[6 ABY]]. Knowing Terex's past deployment at Rothana's shipyards, Corlac liaised with two of his contacts, the ship [[Scavenger|salvagers]] [[Bett]] and [[Wenda]], on the planet [[Kaddak]]. Corlac introduced Terex to his contacts, and they discussed using the latter's expertise on the Rothana shipyards. Corlac promised Terex that they would use the ships to help regroup scattered Imperial forces, but in reality, Corlac and the ship salvagers were looking to amass a pirate [[fleet]].[[Poe Dameron 10|''Poe Dameron'' 10]] Corlac and the salvagers infiltrated the shipyards above Rothana with Terex's help, salvaging many vessels and ship parts, including the ''Carrion Spike''. Corlac, Bett, and Wenda intended on betraying Terex to start their pirate business, but Terex learned of their true intentions in [[7 ABY]] and killed them first. Nevertheless deciding that Imperial order could never be returned to the galaxy, Terex used their team and the resources from Rothana to form a pirate group known as the [[Ranc Gang]]. ==Inhabitants== Those native to the world were known as Rothanians, and they had a complex etiquette that made outsiders stand out. Rothana Heavy Engineering's workforce was famed for its diligence. ==Locations== Rothana included a number of underground factories, as well as honeycombed orbital shipyards. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Rothana_Factory.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Rothana in the ''Star Wars'' Legends continuity]] Rothana was introduced to the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] when it was mentioned in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2014]] novel [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]. The world made its first appearance in a flashback in the [[Poe Dameron 9|ninth issue]] of [[Marvel Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Poe Dameron]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, written by [[Charles Soule]], penciled by [[Phil Noto]], and published on [[December 14]], [[2016]].{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/57994/poe_dameron_2016_9|text=Star Wars: Poe Dameron (2016) #9}} The [[Planet/Legends|planet]]''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, first being mentioned in the name of [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #52]], an [[in-universe]] news issue{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|business/13418_2.html|Mining Guild to Fine Exarga}} that was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}} and released on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[April 18]], [[2002]].{{JCFCite|url=posts/6490675|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072939/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-11#post-6490675}} Rothana was first mentioned separately in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', written by [[Curtis Saxton]]''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' and published [[April 23|five days later]].{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}} Rothana was first illustrated by [[John Van Fleet]] in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R.
